description: This file contains React components and functions related to embedding tools in the Notesnook editor, including alignment, properties popup, and settings for embed elements.

methods.name: EmbedSettings
methods.description: Renders embed settings tools if the embed is active and toolbar is at the bottom.

methods.name: EmbedAlignLeft
methods.description: Button to align embed to the left.

methods.name: EmbedAlignRight
methods.description: Button to align embed to the right.

methods.name: EmbedAlignCenter
methods.description: Button to align embed to the center.

methods.name: EmbedProperties
methods.description: Component to show and edit embed properties via a popup.
